# Arbor — Codebase Intelligence & Developer Workbench

> Turn a GitHub repository into an inspectable architecture map, dependency graph, and health report. Audit time varies with repository size and processing conditions.

## Overview
Arbor helps developers inspect software structure and repository health. Its audits use Babel AST parsing and explicit static checks rather than generative AI. The same source and rule set produce repeatable structural checks; results cover the checks Arbor implements and do not replace code review.

## Key Capabilities
- **Architecture and health audits**: Summarizes repository structure, dependencies, technical debt, performance, security, documentation, and design-system signals.
- **Dependency maps**: Visualizes analyzed module imports and surfaces detected circular dependencies.
- **Evidence-backed findings**: Shows relevant file paths and line locations for supported checks.
- **Secret and environment checks**: Flags patterns that may indicate committed credentials and identifies environment variables not documented in an example file.
- **Interactive API explorer and documentation**: Includes an OpenAPI runner and versioned Markdown documentation hub.
- **Dynamic README badges**: Generates SVG repository-score badges at `/api/badge/[slug]`.

## Security & Privacy
- **Temporary working copy**: Arbor uses a shallow repository copy during analysis and removes it when processing finishes. Stored reports contain derived results such as scores, structure, dependency relationships, and findings—not complete source files.
- **Source analysis**: The repository audit uses AST and rule-based checks; source files are not submitted to a generative AI service as part of that audit.
- **GitHub permissions**: GitHub OAuth currently requests the `repo` scope. Review the permissions on GitHub's authorization screen before connecting. You can also analyze public repositories without granting private-repository access.
- **Token security**: Stored OAuth tokens and personal access tokens are encrypted by the application.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Community (Free)**: Up to 3 connected repositories with audits, dependency maps, and README badges.
- **Pro ($15/month — Waitlist)**: Planned expanded repository limits, scheduled health sync, team workspaces with RBAC, and GitHub Actions integrations.

## Canonical URLs
- Website: https://arborgit.vercel.app
- Sign In: https://arborgit.vercel.app/login
- Dynamic SVG Badges: https://arborgit.vercel.app/api/badge/[slug]
